title: Mask Adoption Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior is adopted and sustained in a population under social influence, information campaigns, supply constraints, and policy enforcement.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People influence each other’s mask-wearing through network interactions; adoption probability depends on the fraction of neighbors wearing masks and individual susceptibility.

interactions.name: policy_compliance
interactions.description: People decide whether to comply with recommendations or mandates; locations and authorities enforce rules and apply penalties or deny entry.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: Health authority and media outlets broadcast messages that affect risk perception, trust, and attitudes.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People attempt to purchase masks; supply and price affect successful acquisition and subsequent usage.

interactions.name: access_control
interactions.description: Locations with enforcement restrict access to non-compliant individuals, influencing subsequent adoption decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Daily fraction of the population wearing masks.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mask adoption fraction at the end of the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until at least 50% of the population adopts mask-wearing.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum adoption fraction observed and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: average_compliance_in_mandated_locations
metrics.description: Average fraction of compliant entries into locations that require masks during mandate periods.

metrics.name: adoption_churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which individuals switch from adopting to not adopting masks over time.

metrics.name: equity_gap_index
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between defined demographic or socioeconomic groups.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to policy (e.g., difference-in-differences between mandate and pre-mandate periods).

validation_criteria.name: steady_state_reached
validation_criteria.description: Absolute day-to-day change in adoption rate below epsilon for N consecutive days (e.g., <0.001 for 7 days).

validation_criteria.name: run_to_run_stability
validation_criteria.description: Coefficient of variation of final_adoption_rate across multiple runs with different seeds is below a threshold (e.g., <5%).

validation_criteria.name: logistic_shape_fit
validation_criteria.description: Adoption curve over time fits a logistic function with acceptable R-squared (e.g., R^2 >= 0.8), indicative of diffusion dynamics.

validation_criteria.name: constraints_respected
validation_criteria.description: State variables remain within valid bounds (e.g., adoption_rate in [0,1], non-negative supply).
